svg.title: A10 HUBBLE CARINA CLOCK engineering architecture
svg.desc: Separate profile estimators compare to an orbit filtered through a causal wind model. Time conventions and nuisance offsets are explicit; line-only fits do not establish inclination or stellar masses.
